state.project: GTC: Hartwell Energy - Middle Fork 230kV Line
state.description: Construct a new 230kV line, approx. 35 miles, from Hartwell Energy to Middle Fork with 200C (2) 1351 ACSS conductor. GTC: Expand Hartwell Energy 230kV and Middle Fork 230kV as necessary to install breakers to accept new line termination.

q.instructions: Is this town a fair approximate location for the endpoint?

criteria.true: The endpoint is named after this town (e.g. 'Bluffton' substation near Bluffton, SC).
criteria.false: The name only shares a word with the town or clearly refers to something elsewhere (e.g. 'Union Pier' is not Union, SC).
